summary: Frontend-only regression for Landing retirement teaser additions: pension/CPP-OAS slider, shareable-link prefill via URL params, copy-link button, and FR + CTA regression. All 5 test groups PASS at 100%. Monte-Carlo recomputes as expected when pension slider changes (median $1.79M at $0 pension vs $4.36M at $40k; success band moves from 'Needs attention' to 'On track'). URL params ca/ra/sv/mo/in/pen correctly prefill all 6 sliders. Copy-link writes a URL containing all 6 params + #calculator to clipboard and shows success toast. teaser-cta still navigates to /login?mode=register. FR toggle correctly relabels pension to 'Prestations gouvernementales / an (RPC/SV)' and share button to 'Copier le lien du résultat'. Minor: observed background 401 console errors on an unrelated resource (not blocking any teaser feature).
critical_code_review_comments: Background 401 console error on page load (unrelated to teaser) — investigate which resource/endpoint is returning 401 on public landing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Teaser pension slider + shareable link (prefill via ?ca&ra&sv&mo&in&pen and copy-link button) verified end-to-end. Clipboard permissions granted via playwright context successfully read copied URL. Monte-Carlo values are stochastic; use directional checks (changed vs unchanged) rather than exact value asserts.
